phase_name: Rollback Approval Evidence Implementation Independent Verification
summary: Phase 149M -- Rollback Approval Evidence Implementation Independent Verification: independent adversarial verification of Phase 149L's RAE-001 v1.0 approval-evidence implementation. Reconstructed the exact 149L production diff (one new module, two new schemas, one additive schema_resources accessor -- no UNRELATED hunk); independently confirmed agent.py/commands/agent.py/mutation_permission.py/permission_broker_foundation.py/permission_broker.py/docs/contracts/** byte-unchanged since 149K. Built a 53-test independently-constructed adversarial suite (tests/test_phase_149m_rollback_approval_evidence_implementation_independent_verification.py, no 149L fixture reuse) attacking canonical provenance, AG3/AG5 binding, family lock, TTL boundaries, timezone handling, revocation, supersession, replay, lookup, path traversal, and digest tampering. Found four BLOCKING defects sharing one root cause: the module's canonicality enforcement reduces to digest self-consistency plus reference to a real CHGR record's declared fields, never proof the record was produced by the legitimate creation API. (F1) A hand-authored Binding file written directly into the canonical bindings/ directory, referencing a genuine published Decision but with an arbitrary rollback_operation_reference, resolves VALID -- bypassing RAE-REQ-019's at-most-one-active-Binding-per-Decision rule, enforced only at the creation-API call site, never at resolution time. (F2) A fully hand-authored CHGR-record-shaped file written directly to CHGR's own records/ path (no Confirmation/Authorization/Publication having occurred) is accepted as canonical by _resolve_decision_ref, and a Binding referencing it resolves VALID. (F4a) A verbatim copy of a legitimate Binding's serialized bytes placed under a new evidence_id filename resolves VALID under that new filename -- filename and internal evidence_id are never cross-checked. (F4b) A hand-authored Binding with a forged later created_at, referencing the same real Decision and operation reference as a legitimate still-fresh Binding, causes the legitimate Binding to resolve SUPERSEDED -- a working denial-of-evidence attack requiring only filesystem write access to the already-canonical evidence directory. One NON-BLOCKING regression independently reproduced against the pre-149L baseline: 149L's module docstring's prose mention of pcae.cltr.authority.* trips three unrelated, naive string-scanning TAM/CLTR regression-guard tests (136z, 136ai, 136av) that 149L's own phase report did not surface -- no actual import boundary violation (AST-confirmed). All other RAE-001 v1.0 dimensions independently verified CONFORMS. Verdict: NOT VERIFIED -- BLOCKING RAE-001 IMPLEMENTATION FINDINGS. Integration readiness: NOT READY. See docs/PHASE_149M_ROLLBACK_APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md.
